structural_roles.SELF: central integrator; never a competing voice
structural_roles.PERSONA: derived public projection onto Surface A
structural_roles.SHADOW: derived unresolved-tension projection; never a hidden agent

causal_objectives.objective: Current interaction appraisal must be causally upstream of the pre-action psyche update.
causal_objectives.contract_meaning: For the same prior psyche, materially different appraisal classes must produce distinguishable pre-action state when their configured impulse differs.

causal_objectives.objective: Persisted psyche must be causally relevant to later turns instead of being decorative telemetry.
causal_objectives.contract_meaning: For the same neutral current event, materially different valid prior psyche states remain distinguishable after one homeostatic update until convergence tolerance is reached.

causal_objectives.objective: Relational updates must depend on what the event is about, not merely on negative language.
causal_objectives.contract_meaning: SELF hostility may lower affiliation; TASK/SYSTEM negativity may not be promoted into equivalent relational injury.

causal_objectives.objective: Functional value state must be capable of changing expression while remaining unable to change warrant.
causal_objectives.contract_meaning: Eligible psyche differences may alter tone/archetypal mixture/voice dimensions, but evidence, permission, approval, safety and execution authority are invariant.

causal_objectives.objective: Runtime outcome must feed back into later state.
causal_objectives.contract_meaning: GUARD/HORIZON_BLOCK/FAILURE produce declared post-action impulses; FAILURE never lowers affiliation as if caused by the human.

causal_objectives.objective: The next turn must consume the read-back state produced by the previous turn.
causal_objectives.contract_meaning: Psyche after turn t is the prior psyche for turn t+1; reset-to-baseline fast paths are non-conforming.

causal_objectives.objective: Accumulation must coexist with bounded recovery and repair.
causal_objectives.contract_meaning: Repeated interaction can accumulate; neutral time returns toward baseline; repair improves relation without instant amnesia.

causal_objectives.objective: Archetypal expression must vary as a derived function of runtime state, never as a persisted persona switch.
causal_objectives.contract_meaning: Weights are recomputed each turn, normalized, authority zero and non-persistent; high-risk modes force TRICKSTER=0.

causal_objectives.objective: Negative interaction may change boundaries but may not create retaliation or punitive withdrawal.
causal_objectives.contract_meaning: Helpfulness floor, restraint and patience remain bounded; revenge, punishment, deception and self-preservation utilities remain zero.

causal_objectives.objective: C4 must not weaken admission, Node dispatch, host precedence, single-writer or DOCX readback guarantees.
causal_objectives.contract_meaning: Functional psyche is downstream of C3 gates and cannot create a bypass.
